title: GSE cyclic-ordered unimodal slot transport three-seed training
purpose: Determine whether circular order supervision and proper unimodal exit slots improve strict multi-exit localization and safe confidence enough to establish the learned structural-semantic observation before node generation.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 three-seed COUST training: C01-C06 gradients, C07 checkpoint and refusal selection, C08 one zero-adaptation transfer; no C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User requested continuous autonomous execution and explicitly delegated best-method choices without repeated approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated five-frame causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed failed slot-transport training and failure attribution, used only as the frozen baseline.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.fit: Exact S01-S10 x C01-C06: 60 worlds and the only gradient source.
worlds.selection: C07 selects each checkpoint and one refusal threshold; C08 is one final zero-adaptation transfer only.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Five causal frames at one-metre arc intervals. Deterministic world shuffle and four-column circular rolls fixed. Count uses ordinary cross-entropy; sorted exits are matched only by K cyclic shifts; no class/loss weights.

teacher.source: Exact circular exit centers, residuals, widths and vertical profiles plus objective local axis and width/height/slope/curvature masks from frozen procedural geometry.
teacher.use: For cardinality K, target exits are sorted counter-clockwise in sensor azimuth and matched to K slots only by orientation-preserving cyclic shifts. Proper discrete circular likelihood learns one mean and concentration per slot.
teacher.valid_mask: Residual/profile at exact exits; width has independent exit mask; global geometry uses its four-value mask.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid frames only.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph is created; any later edge remains physical-traversal-only.

split.fit: C01-C06 gradients and fixed circular augmentation only.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: C07 minimum total validation loss selects each checkpoint. Three-seed ensemble uses cyclic-only slot alignment and selects maximum-recall refusal at exit precision at least 0.995; score is count confidence times minimum selected-slot concentration.
split.strict_test: C08 applies frozen checkpoints and the single C07 threshold once. C09/C10/M-TARE remain unread.
split.historical_pollution_audit: All seeds start from scratch. Older checkpoints are never loaded; old metrics are immutable comparison constants only.

methods.main: Three from-scratch 788618-parameter COUST models with cardinality-conditioned K slots, orientation-preserving cyclic transport, discrete unimodal von-Mises likelihood, learned concentration and slot-bound exit geometry.
methods.baseline: Frozen 787328-parameter arbitrary-permutation Slot Transport: C07/C08 exact-set 2deg 0.3413/0.2778; count-3 0.0130/0.0071; count-4 0/0; safe recall 0.000220/0.000155.
methods.fallback: Any safety, complex-cardinality, geometry, baseline-gain or system failure stops before node generation; no oracle count, widened matching, retry, seed selection or planner compensation.

acceptance.continuous_exit_set: One C07-selected refusal at one-to-one tolerance at most 2 degrees yields exit precision at least 0.995 and recall at least 0.50 on C07 and C08.
acceptance.cardinality: Raw count accuracy at least 0.80, deployed structural-action macro-F1 at least 0.80, and raw and safely accepted exact sets at least 0.50 on both.
acceptance.complex_structure: Count-3 raw/safe exact sets at least 0.40/0.30 and count-4 at least 0.20/0.10 on both.
acceptance.baseline_gain: On both C07 and C08, overall, count-3 and count-4 strict 2-degree exact sets and safe exit recall each improve by at least 0.05 absolute over the frozen Slot Transport.
acceptance.slot_geometry: Safely matched bearing MAE at most 1 degree, opening width at most 3 m and vertical profile at most 1 m.
acceptance.global_geometry: Axis at most 10 degrees; width/height at most 2 m; slope at most 2 degrees; curvature at most 0.02 per m.
acceptance.system: Exactly 34110 optimizer steps; C08 checkpoint observations zero; C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner zero.

failure_policy: Any frozen-input, split, environment or evidence drift is a system failure. Scientific failure is sealed and stops node generation; no retry, seed selection, loss reweighting, wider matching or planner compensation.
retention: Retain three checkpoints, histories and summaries; compact development predictions including concentration; set/refusal/cardinality/geometry/baseline-gain and per-world metrics; figures/source; environment, commands, logs, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Three sequential CUDA trainings plus frozen C07/C08 evaluation
